L: Distance from the grating to the wall
N: Number of slits the beam lights
n: Lines per millimeter of the grating; in the Balmer formula, the upper level's number
theta: Angle from the straight through beam
theta_m: Angle of order m from the straight through beam
y: Distance of a spot from the central spot on the wall, B − A
y_m: Position of the order m spot, from the central spot
